pending_buyback_observable.meaning: a pending buyBack() transaction targeting a V3 pool is observable in the public mempool before execution

amount_out_minimum.meaning: amountOutMinimum parameter set by the V3 _performSwap path

sqrt_price_limit_x96.meaning: sqrtPriceLimitX96 parameter set by the V3 _performSwap path

post_swap_validation_present.meaning: the V3 swap path performs a post-swap validation (report states it does not, unlike V2)

effective_slippage_protection_enforced.meaning: the V3 buyback swap enforces effective slippage protection so it does not execute at an arbitrarily inflated price

protocol_receives_less_than_fair_olas.meaning: the protocol receives significantly less OLAS than fair value from the buyback swap, a direct financial loss

assumptions: The attack relies on a standard MEV sandwich technique and public mempool visibility (as_mev_technique).
Fair OLAS value is not numerically defined in the report; the impact is expressed as a qualitative Boolean relation.
The buyback swap is executed by the protocol's BuyBackBurnerBalancer contract against a Balancer V3 (Slipstream) pool.

unresolved.description: Report does not give exact OLAS amounts or a numeric fair-value reference, so the 'significantly less than fair value' relation is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric inequality.
Report does not state who calls buyBack() or any authorization requirement.

limitations: The selected impact is formalized only as the qualitative 'protocol receives less than fair OLAS value' relation; the up-to-100% extraction magnitude (i_up_to_100_percent) and repeatability (i_repeatable) are separate impacts not covered by this plan.
Exploitability is conditional on public mempool visibility; a private mempool mitigation is noted but not modeled.
Whether the attacker's front-run buy and back-run sell are separate transactions is not specified and is not encoded.
